top_candidates.subject: [Clang] support for outputs along indirect edges of asm goto
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit adds Clang support for asm goto outputs on indirect edges by changing code generation to split indirect destinations when outputs are present and to materialize output stores separately for each successor block. The implementation introduces bookkeeping for per-destination register results, rewrites callbr emission to synthesize split blocks for indirect targets, and then emits asm output stores at each split destination. It also updates documentation and codegen tests to reflect the new semantics and block naming.
Mechanisms: asm goto code generation semantics; callbr successor splitting; per-successor output materialization; basic block synthesis for indirect edges; post-callbr store emission
Touched symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt; EmitAsmStores; llvm::CallBrInst; llvm::DenseMap; clang::CodeGenFunction; asm goto tests in clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto.c; clang/test/CodeGen/asm-goto2.c
Risk relevance: Directly changes asm-goto lowering, which is highly relevant to crashes involving asm goto outputs and optimizer interaction; Introduces new CFG shape by splitting indirect destinations, which can affect loop analysis, dominance, and exit-value rewriting; Adds extra IR extraction/store paths for outputs, increasing the chance of miscompiled SSA or invalid successor handling; Could interact with later optimizer passes that reason about loop exits and SCEV-based expansion
Build risk: Adds new IR-generation logic and DenseMap-based state tracking in Clang CodeGen; Updates multiple codegen tests and module tests to expect different block names and CFG structure; Changes documented language semantics, which may require coordinated frontend/backend behavior
